originals.why: Does not contain the LEGO mae o’n ddeud (only 'mae dal rhaid i mi ddeud'), so it doesn't practise 'he says' at all

originals.ko: 그는 내가 무엇을 했는지 너한테 말할 거야
originals.why: 'mae o’n' belongs to 'mae o’n mynd i' (he's going to). The phrase never uses mae o’n ddeud in its taught sense 'he says'

refill.why: Only one USE needed. The bare 그걸 could be heard as hynny or hynna, and the Welsh has no question mark.
Only one USE needed. 보고 싶다 is ambiguous between 'wants to see' and 'misses', so it does not point to one Welsh answer.
Only one USE needed. 도울 거라고 could be either mynd i helpu or neith helpu.
Only one USE needed. The sentence is good, but U01 is simpler and reuses the seed's 뭐라고 frame.
Only one USE needed. -해서 could be either achos or felly, and fod o ddim yn barod is weaker than nad ydy o'n barod.
